description: The core APIs the widget's two windows need. Commands defined by this app (read_quota, set_expanded, set_pinned, set_panel_size, hide_popover, widget_state, system_theme) are not listed: application commands are not gated by the ACL, only core and plugin commands are. No filesystem, shell, http or dialog permission is granted, because the frontend does none of that - the Rust side does the reading and hands over parsed JSON.
